_comment: This file documents all secrets required for local development. NO actual values here.
_instructions: Set values using: dotnet user-secrets set 'Key' 'value' --project src/<Project>
Parameters:feedbackhmackey: <32+ character random value, distinct from Jwt:SigningKey>
_section_api: ---- Api (standalone, without Aspire) ---- Run from src/SentenceStudio.Api
_comment_feedback_hmac: Signs feedback preview tokens. MUST be its own value, never Jwt:SigningKey — the host refuses to start outside Development/Testing if it is missing, shorter than 32 characters, or equal to Jwt:SigningKey. Development and Testing generate an ephemeral per-process key, so this is only required for real deployments.
Feedback:HmacKey: <32+ character random value, distinct from Jwt:SigningKey>
_section_webapp: ---- WebApp (standalone, without Aspire) ---- Run from src/SentenceStudio.WebApp
_section_maui: ---- MAUI Apps (AppLib appsettings.json, gitignored) ---- Copy appsettings.template.json to appsettings.json in src/SentenceStudio.AppLib/
